name: Vizzy's Room
source:
Hello! My name is Vizzy! But you can call me Viz for short. Welcome to my room! 

Vizzy's Room is a short visual novel that explores how a game might feel after it's been abandoned for so long. What happens when you find out that a program that's been sitting on your hard drive for years is sentient and has feelings? How far would you go to keep them company before ultimately forgetting about them once more?

[from [url=https://mettaseven.itch.io/vizzys-room]Itch.io[/url]]
